items.title: Al Gallodoro Interview, 1966-05-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Mr. Caleduro, who was it that I called you the Triple Threat Instrumentl? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, that was Selma. Mr. Selma?

ctx.x: Yeah, red dots. Yeah, I have that. Red and white. You have that. Yeah. Alt V, the violin solo. Right. Dark Eyes, the charred eyes. Liza and... Indian Summer, Summertime. You get enough kids to write to Mitch Miller out, but he'd release it. He'd see that. Yes. You'd have to get a good manager, too, to open this thing up. See, what's terrible about it is that they have the masters and the records to be sold. It's just a sin having it lay there. And if you're offered to buy, goodness knows what they want. What a…
Mr. Caleduro, who was it that I called you the Triple Threat Instrumentl?
Oh, that was Selma. Mr. Selma?
